item.title: Wendy Ortiz spared red carpet interview after revealing her anxiety over StableRonaldo feud
item.description: Popular streamer Wendy Ortiz, anxious about a public feud with StableRonaldo, will not face red carpet interviews at the Streamer Awards. StableRonaldo personally assured Ortiz via private message, easing her stress and allowing her to attend comfortably. This gesture highlights a rare moment of consideration, prioritizing professional interactions amidst online disputes and safeguarding personal comfort at major events.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: “Come on my show tomorrow”: Candace Owens hits Nick Fuentes with receipts after he slams her over TPUSA livestream date
item.description: Candace Owens and Nick Fuentes engaged in a public spat over a Turning Point USA livestream. Owens criticized TPUSA for a short notice, while Fuentes accused her of avoiding a direct confrontation. Owens countered by sharing past messages showing Fuentes also rescheduled interviews. The dispute highlights ongoing tensions surrounding the Charlie Kirk livestream.

item.title: How valuable MrBeast’s Beast Industries has become and what it means for fans
item.description: Beast Industries, spearheaded by MrBeast, is now valued at an estimated $5 billion, positioning it as a major creator-led business. CEO Jeff Housenbold hinted at a potential IPO, aiming to allow fans, not just institutions, to own shares. This move could transform viewers into investors, fostering unprecedented brand loyalty and global expansion powered by its massive audience.

item.title: 'Low self-esteem': Ann Coulter targets Ro Khanna, Pramila Jayapal for their India support amid Trump's crackdown on immigration
item.description: Though India is not facing any immigration ban, it became a center of the debate as two Indian-origin Democrats objected to President Donald Trump's crackdown on immigrants. Pramila Jayapal said being undocumented is not a crime in itself and Ro Khanna criticized Trump's use of the phrase 'third-world countries' and said his parents would have never been welcome to the US, had Trump had his way.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'Damaged so many lives': Indian-origin doctor Oumair Aejaz in Michigan sentenced to over 35 years for secretly filming women, children; wife made 1st complaint
item.description: An Indian-origin former doctor, Oumair Aejaz, received a 35-60 year prison sentence for secretly recording over 13,000 videos of women and children. The investigation began after his wife discovered the recordings, which included their own children and female relatives, as well as victims at a swim school and hospitals.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: KSI drops a major India announcement with CarryMinati joining him for “Try Not To Laugh IRL” in Mumbai
item.description: Global creator KSI announced his arrival in India for the "Try Not To Laugh IRL – India Edition" video shoot in Mumbai on January 8. He revealed popular Indian creators CarryMinati, Abhishek Malhan, Tanmay Bhat, and Samay Raina will be judges for the show, where contestants can win ₹1 lakh by making a judge laugh.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: How orbital satellite megaconstellations could change astronomy forever
item.description: Satellite megaconstellations are increasingly impacting astronomical observations. Bright satellite streaks are compromising ground and space-based telescope images, while radio telescopes struggle with growing orbital radio noise. This crowded orbit challenges future missions and affects long-term research by increasing light scatter and debris, necessitating new strategies to preserve sky clarity for scientific discovery.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: Expert warns 60% of humanity could die in 72 hours if North Korea, the US, and Russia trigger WWIII
item.description: Annie Jacobsen’s Nuclear War: A Scenario maps a chilling, minute-by-minute nuclear conflict, blending declassified sources, expert interviews, and climate models. She explores not just the immediate destruction, but the cascading famine, societal collapse, and global fallout that would follow. Through vivid scenarios, Jacobsen asks readers to confront the fragile assumptions of deterrence and the stark realities of modern nuclear strategy.
item.dc:creator: TOI Trending Desk

item.title: Expect massive visa backlogs: Ex-USCIS official's warning as Trump orders review of Green Cards
item.description: US Visa news: USCIS has now been burdened with additional task of reviewing all immigration cases from 19 countries of concern. The agency has been asked to proceed case-by-case, calling the applicants for interview and reinterview to decide whether they should be given asylum, Green Card etc. This will lead to an overall visa backlog as USCIS has limited manpower, a former official said.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'Netflix may become the Obama News Network': MAGA activist Laura Loomer's warning on Warner Bros acquisition
item.description: Netflix's massive $72-$83 billion acquisition of Warner Bros Discovery, including HBO and DC, sparks controversy. MAGA activist Laura Loomer warns of an "Obama News Network," citing the Obamas' Netflix deal and Netflix executives' political donations. While Netflix aims to boost content, critics fear political influence and media consolidation ahead of elections.

item.title: Dubai Police adds Ferrari Purosangue, a 755hp beast, to its luxury patrol lineup
item.description: Dubai Police has unveiled a rare, customized Ferrari Purosangue Mansory. This powerful vehicle joins their luxury patrol fleet, enhancing visibility in tourist spots like Burj Khalifa. The addition marks 12 years of using supercars for security and community engagement. The fleet aims to boost safety and showcase Dubai's innovation.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Pakistan military revamp: Defence ministry notifies appointment of Asim Munir as Chief of Defence Forces; 5-year tenure begins
item.description: Pakistan has officially appointed Field Marshal Asim Munir as the country's first Chief of Defence Forces (CDF), a significant military restructuring. This new role consolidates operational and strategic authority under a single command, aiming for faster decision-making. Munir will concurrently serve as Chief of Army Staff for a five-year term.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: “I can count on that”: Inside Linus Sebastian's business empire as YouTuber breaks down how his tech channel really makes money
item.description: Tech YouTuber Linus Sebastian revealed Linus Media Group's impressive financial performance, detailing over $26 million earned through YouTube AdSense and significant revenue from products, sponsorships, and memberships. Sebastian highlighted the importance of predictable income streams like FloatPlane, crediting supporters for the company's multi-stream business success and resilience against viewership fluctuations.

item.title: Why are fans questioning Pokimane's relationship status amid celibacy rumors? Her latest statement sparks huge buzz
item.description: Popular streamer Pokimane has sparked online discussion with her personal confession about celibacy. The 29-year-old shared that pacing intimacy offers benefits like avoiding attachment to incompatible people and preserving energy for personal goals. She also highlighted emotional safety and reduced stress as advantages. This follows her recent self-proposal video, adding to her viral moments.

item.title: Candace Owens alleges TPUSA leaders betrayed Charlie Kirk before deadly shooting and vows to show evidence
item.description: Candace Owens claims Charlie Kirk was betrayed by people within Turning Point USA and plans to release proof. She urged donors to seek refunds, stating leadership was aware. This assertion has caused tension, with Christian influencer Allie Beth Stuckey pushing back against Owens' claims and emphasizing the need for truth and careful speech.
